column1: # Expected decision for every command in harvest.jsonl, by 1-based row.
# Authored from the grammar in docs/spec-a2-h3.md, not read back out of the
# handler, so the handler is graded against the SPEC rather than against
# itself. The thirteen denials are enumerated with the class each one falls
# in; a reader can check every one against the row it names.
# This file is the positive control. Forty-four of the reviewer's real
# commands must pass, or the grammar denies legitimate reads mid-review, which
# is the failure step zero exists to prevent.
